description: A coalition of EU member states and industry groups formally challenges the enforceability of the AI Deployment Boundary Act in the European Court of Justice, arguing that its extraterritorial monitoring requirements violate international trade agreements and national sovereignty. The case gains momentum as legal experts warn of a constitutional crisis if the Court rules against the Commission.

University graduates in Germany, France, and Italy begin coordinated protests against AI-driven hiring filters that exclude entry-level applicants en masse, with sit-ins at public employment offices and tech campuses. The movement gains traction as leaked internal HR reports confirm widespread automated rejection of human candidates without review.
